title: The 2026 Marketing Plan: Ship Constantly and Become Agent-Ready
description:
For the rest of 2026, I’m doubling down on 3 things in marketing.

Ship constantly.
Build for AI agents.
Double down on organic social.

The goal is simple: stay top of mind while building the infrastructure for where marketing is going.

Comment "NEWSLETTER" and I'll send you more insights on AI, business, and marketing.
